Description
 The University of Wolverhampton is a public institution located in the West Midlands, England. Established in 1827 as the Wolverhampton Tradesmen's and Mechanics' Institute, it achieved university status in 1992. With over 29,400 students and 2,100 staff, the university offers a broad range of foundation, undergraduate, and postgraduate courses, many accredited by prestigious professional bodies. It operates across multiple campuses in Wolverhampton, Walsall, Telford, and the University of Wolverhampton Science Park .
